Let it rainA little serendipity on autopilot
No right notes. Just your notes.
WELCOME TO CHROMAFLOW

A small space to play.

Click the canvas to release a droplet. It falls, blooms into the fluid, and plays a note from the current chord.

Choose a color to use only that color and voice for painting, automatic rain, and blooms. Turn on Cycle colors beside the palette to bring back the variety. The horizontal position moves from low notes to high notes, always within your chord. Drag to paint a stream of notes.

Press Begin listening to enable sound. With Let it rain on, droplets arrive on their own. Turn it off for a completely hands-on instrument.
